calculation.description: For each asset, average over three completed sessions the signed candle pressure, where positive values indicate bearish bodies (open above close) relative to the daily high-low range. Higher values are a contrarian long signal for next-day return. Zero ranges are treated as missing.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (+0.05063), 2023-2024 (+0.04973), and 2025-2026 (+0.04784). Small cross-asset universe requires conservative interpretation; 15 assets available and dates with at least 8 valid names were used.
